item.title: Guardians' Jo Adell embraces reunion in encounter vs. Angels
item.description: Jo Adell had the perfect role model during his six-plus seasons with the Los Angeles Angels.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: Jo Adell had the perfect role model during his six-plus seasons with the Los Angeles Angels. Now that he's with the Cleveland Guardians, he's putting many of his lessons learned from three-time American League MVP Mike Trout to good use. Adell will face his former teammate for the first time since the Angels traded him to the Guardians on Aug. 3, likely starting in right field when Cleveland opens a three-game series on Monday night in Anaheim, Calif. "He's unbelievable at setting up at-bats and getting his pitch," Adell said of Trout. "Watching him just really destroy those pitches and really set the pitcher up to be able to get them and not miss them. ... I had front-row seats for a while." Adell has 17 RBIs through his first 17 games with the Guardians, who have won four games in a row to pull even with the Texas Rangers in the chase for the final wild-card berth in the American League. "Obviously, it's my first time being traded, but coming in, the focus was just about how to put wins up and to be yourself, and they made that crystal clear when I got here," Adell said. "My focus is to help this team and drive some runs in when I get the opportunity, and things have been good so far." Left-hander Parker Messick (9-8, 2.54 ERA) will start for the Guardians on Monday. Messick comes in with the third-best ERA in the American League behind Cam Schlittler (2.16) of the New York Yankees and Dylan Cease (2.37) of the Toronto Blue Jays. Messick has suffered from a lack of run support at times, including in his past two starts. He held the Detroit Tigers to two runs over 5 2/3 innings on Aug. 13, but the Guardians were blanked 3-0. Messick surrendered one run over 6 2/3 innings last Wednesday against the San Francisco Giants, but again Cleveland couldn't muster any runs and lost 1-0. "Anytime you're not scoring runs, it's very frustrating, especially when your pitchers are out there dominating," Guardians catcher Austin Hedges said. "We only gave up one run (against the Giants). Obviously, we expect to win those games." Messick made his only start against the Angels on May 13 and earned the win after limiting them to two runs and four hits in 5 2/3 innings of a 4-2 victory in Cleveland. The Angels are returning home after going 3-3 on a six-game road trip through Texas. Los Angeles had a chance to win a second straight road series for the first time since last year but lost 5-3 to the Rangers on Sunday. Angels left-hander Yusei Kikuchi struggled in his return from a nearly four-month absence due to shoulder problems, giving up five runs over five innings. The Angels will send rookie right-hander George Klassen to the mound against Cleveland on Monday. Klassen (2-1, 3.74 ERA) has made five MLB starts this season and three in a row since his most recent recall from the minors on Aug. 7. He was nearly unhittable in his most recent outing Tuesday against the Houston Astros, allowing just one hit over seven scoreless innings in a 3-1 win. "That was some of the best stuff we've seen all year," Angels manager Kurt Suzuki said. "Attacking with his fastball and pretty nasty sliders, but I think it was more commanding the zone, getting ahead and really just on the attack. He didn't make it too complicated, knew what he did best and went after them." --Field Level Media

item.title: Cobre se fortalece al disparar las compras el metal destinado a salir de la LME
item.description: Los precios del cobre subían el lunes, ya que el aumento de órdenes canceladas o del metal destinado a la entrega en la Bolsa de Metales de Londres (LME), desencadenó una oleada de compras, mientras que la depreciación del dólar reforzaba el optimismo respecto a los metales industriales cotizados en el billete verde.
item.dc:creator: Pratima Desai
item.content:encoded: Los precios del cobre subían el lunes, ya que el aumento de órdenes canceladas o del metal destinado a la entrega en la Bolsa de Metales de Londres (LME), desencadenó una oleada de compras, mientras que la depreciación del dólar reforzaba el optimismo respecto a los metales industriales cotizados en el billete verde. * El cobre de referencia en la LME ganaba un 0,2%, a 14.240 dólares por tonelada. Los precios de este metal, utilizado en los sectores de la energía y la construcción, alcanzaron los 14.396 dólares la semana pasada, el nivel más alto desde el máximo de 14.527,5 dólares registrado en enero. * Las cancelaciones están ocurriendo sobre todo en almacenes registrados en la LME en Estados Unidos y Asia —en zonas de libre comercio— y es probable que se entreguen a la Comex o a operadores y consumidores dentro de Estados Unidos, según fuentes del sector. * Los operadores y productores llevan enviando cobre a Estados Unidos desde que el presidente Donald Trump planteó la posibilidad de gravar las importaciones en febrero del año pasado. Las existencias de cobre de la Comex están en picos históricos de 742.778 toneladas cortas (673.836 toneladas métricas). * El zinc sumaba un 0,4%, a 3.838 dólares por tonelada, tras haber tocado 3.850 dólares, su nivel más alto desde junio de 2022, por preocupaciones por la escasez fuera de China, donde las existencias en almacenes autorizados por la Bolsa de Futuros de Shanghái se han más que duplicado este año . * "Una distorsión en la que tanto la oferta como la demanda se están reduciendo hace que el mercado parezca más ajustado de lo que justificaría el débil consumo", señaló en una nota Tom Price, analista de Panmure Liberum. * En otros metales básicos, el aluminio bajaba un 0,1%, a 3.233 dólares la tonelada; el plomo mejoraba un 0,4%, a 1.906 dólares; el estaño ganaba un 0,2%, a 56.000 dólares; y el níquel avanzaba un 0,1%, a 17.080 dólares.

item.title: Trump-linked RUM Group signs $13.7 billion AI deal with US-based cloud client
item.description: RUM Group , which hosts U.S. President Donald Trump's Truth Social platform, said on Monday it has signed a contract with an unnamed U.S.-based cloud customer worth about $13.7 billion to supply AI chips.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: RUM Group (RUM.O) , which hosts U.S. President Donald Trump's Truth Social platform, said on Monday it has signed a contract with an unnamed U.S.-based cloud customer worth about $13.7 billion to supply AI chips. Shares of RUM Group rose more than 8% in premarket trading. Here are some details: Rumble [USN:L4N42P1W3 TEXT:"started operating as RUM Group"] in June after closing its acquisition of German AI cloud company Northern Data, creating a new AI-infrastructure business as it seeks to capitalize on booming AI compute demand. Under the deal, the customer will get access to GPUs and related services from RUM Group's Maysville, Georgia site, which is currently under development. RUM Group said it is giving the unnamed customer the option to buy around 51 million shares of its stock for just one cent each, according to a regulatory filing . The option will become available to the customer gradually over six years, as the client fulfills the purchase agreements. The customer will buy $13.7 billion in GPU services over six years in three parts, with the last instalment contingent on a delivery date approved by the client. RUM Group did not immediately respond to a Reuters request for comment about the customer. The company said it currently lacks the necessary funds and plans to raise capital through debt or equity to fulfill this contract.

item.title: India seize control of Colombo test after Jurel hundred
item.description: Dhruv Jurel's unbeaten 115 powered India to a commanding 503-9 before they declared late on day two of the second and final test against Sri Lanka on Monday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Dhruv Jurel's unbeaten 115 powered India to a commanding 503-9 before they declared late on day two of the second and final test against Sri Lanka on Monday. Rain and bad light meant India could bowl only three overs, which proved enough to prise out Lahiru Udara and nightwatchman Prabath Jayasuriya and restrict Sri Lanka to eight for two, still 495 runs behind. India took control after a resilient lower-order batting display led by Jurel's second test hundred, an innings studded with nine fours and two sixes. India had resumed at 300-5 at the Sinhalese Sports Club Ground, with Rishabh Pant due back after retiring hurt on Sunday following a forearm blow. Seamer Asitha Fernando (4-106) struck in the second over, removing Saransh Jain for six, but the collapse Sri Lanka craved never materialised. Pant joined Jurel to add 112 for the seventh wicket and tighten India's grip. Bruised but undeterred, Pant reached a combative fifty before lunch and departed soon after for 63, stepping out to Nuwantha Keshara and miscuing to long-off. Manav Suthar fell soon after, yet Jurel held firm as India's advantage swelled until rain again forced the players from the field. Jurel lingered on 99 before completing his century with a risky single -- tapping Fernando to mid-off and diving home as a direct hit would have dismissed him. Rising to his feet, he dusted himself off and embraced his partner Mohammed Siraj. Liberated by the milestone, Jurel launched Fernando for six over long-on and, in the seamer's next over, pulled another into the stands. India struck with the ball when Yashasvi Jaiswal flew to his right at third slip to take a catch and dismiss Udara. The deteriorating light forced India to introduce spin, and Suthar struck in his first over by trapping Jayasuriya LBW. Jaiswal and Sri Lanka's Fernando were fined 25% of their match fees and received one demerit point each for their on-field altercation on Sunday.

item.title: Segunda cosecha de maíz en centro-sur de Brasil alcanza el 92%, según AgRural
item.description: Los agricultores del centro-sur de Brasil habían cosechado el 92% de su segunda cosecha de maíz de 2026 hasta el jueves pasado, informó el lunes la consultora agroindustrial AgRural, lo que supone un aumento respecto al 85% de la semana anterior, aunque por debajo del 98% registrado un año antes.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Los agricultores del centro-sur de Brasil habían cosechado el 92% de su segunda cosecha de maíz de 2026 hasta el jueves pasado, informó el lunes la consultora agroindustrial AgRural, lo que supone un aumento respecto al 85% de la semana anterior, aunque por debajo del 98% registrado un año antes. Las labores de campo han concluido en el estado de Mato Grosso y están a punto de finalizar en Goiás y Minas Gerais, según la consultora. En Paraná la cosecha se aceleró, pero la humedad excesiva siguió ralentizando el avance en comparación con los niveles normales. La siembra de la primera cosecha de maíz de Brasil de la temporada 2026/27 cobró impulso la semana pasada, con un 2% de la superficie estimada de la región centro-sur sembrada hasta el jueves, frente al 0,3% de la semana anterior, según AgRural. No obstante, el ritmo se mantuvo por debajo del 3,2% registrado en el mismo momento del año anterior. Las condiciones de humedad siguen limitando los trabajos en el campo en el estado de Rio Grande do Sul, mientras que los agricultores de Paraná y Santa Catarina ya han comenzado a sembrar, añadió la consultora.

item.title: British city's toilet redevelopment is not exclusively for squat facilities
item.description: Content warning: The screenshot contains language that some find offensive.
item.dc:creator: Reuters Fact Check
item.content:encoded: Content warning: The screenshot contains language that some find offensive. An English council’s £1 million ($1.363 million) expenditure on new public toilets has been misrepresented online as only covering the cost of squat-style facilities. Here are the key details: Some of the online posts making the false implication also suggested that the spending was evidence of corruption inside Cambridge City Council. A Cambridge City Council spokesperson told Reuters that it spent £1.026 million to redevelop a block of toilets in the city centre, describing the project as “effectively the construction” of a new facility. The Silver Street facility has 13 different toilets, including three new squat-style toilets, “favoured by some international visitors,” the spokesperson said. There are also six seated toilets, three urinals and an accessible seated toilet. Silver Street Bridge is a hot spot for international tourists, according to a council press release . Verdict: Missing context. There are 13 new toilets in the redeveloped Cambridge facilities, only three of which are squat-style toilets.

item.title: Mexico inflation accelerates in early August
item.description: Mexico's 12-month inflation rate accelerated in early August, data from national statistics agency INEGI showed on Monday, while core inflation remained persistent.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Mexico's 12-month inflation rate accelerated in early August, data from national statistics agency INEGI showed on Monday, while core inflation remained persistent. Annual inflation in Latin America's second-largest economy reached 3.26% in the first half of August, INEGI said, up from 3.10% a month earlier, though still within the Bank of Mexico's target range of 3%, plus or minus one percentage point. On a monthly basis, consumer prices rose 0.10% in the period, INEGI said. The closely watched core price index, which strips out some volatile food and energy prices, rose 3.93% in the 12 months through early August, and climbed 0.08% compared with the first half of July.

item.title: U.S. Treasury to broaden scope of secondary sanctions on Iran, source says
item.description: The action is aimed at giving a final warning to countries to sever their business ties with Iran.
item.dc:creator: David Lawder
item.content:encoded: The U.S. Treasury is expected to broaden the scope of secondary sanctions it can impose on entities and countries that maintain business ties with Iran as the Trump administration seeks on Monday to increase economic pressure on Tehran, a source familiar with the plans told Reuters. The action is aimed at giving a final warning to countries to sever their business ties with Iran in an effort to force an end to the nearly six-month conflict that has bottled up the Strait of Hormuz and Gulf energy exports, said the source, who spoke on condition of anonymity due to not being authorized to speak publicly about the matter. U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent is expected to announce more details of the Iran actions on Monday at a 1 p.m. EDT (1700 GMT) press conference. The source said that Bessent also intended to provide a broader overview of an economic pressure campaign against Iran that he and President Donald Trump have described as an "economic D-Day", and would make it clear to countries that they must side with the U.S. or risk having key companies and entities cut off from the dollar-based financial system.

item.title: La AIE no está debatiendo una segunda liberación de reservas estratégicas de petróleo, dice Birol
item.description: La Agencia Internacional de la Energía (AIE) no está debatiendo por el momento una segunda liberación de reservas estratégicas de petróleo, dijo el lunes a Reuters su director ejecutivo, Fatih Birol.
item.dc:creator: Nora Buli
item.content:encoded: La Agencia Internacional de la Energía (AIE) no está debatiendo por el momento una segunda liberación de reservas estratégicas de petróleo, dijo el lunes a Reuters su director ejecutivo, Fatih Birol. "Por el momento, no", respondió Birol al margen de una conferencia sobre energía en Noruega cuando se le preguntó si la agencia estudiaba una segunda liberación de reservas estratégicas. La AIE sigue siempre los mercados "muy, muy de cerca" y aún queda el 80% de las reservas estratégicas tras la liberación de 400 millones de barriles en marzo, añadió Birol. En cuanto al gas, Birol expresó preocupación por los niveles actuales de las reservas europeas, que se situaban en torno al 62%, según la plataforma de transparencia AGSI. La Unión Europea tiene como objetivo elevar el nivel de llenado al 80% para el 1 de diciembre. "Las reservas están por debajo de los promedios históricos y todavía esperamos recibir gas de Oriente Medio, mientras que, al mismo tiempo, (...) Europa se ha comprometido a eliminar las importaciones de gas ruso", afirmó. "Si tenemos un invierno duro en Europa, podríamos afrontar algunas dificultades".

item.title: Coinbase-backed crypto advocacy group endorses 32 US midterm candidates
item.description: The endorsements come as the Clarity Act, the crypto industry's top policy priority, stalls in the Senate amid opposition from some lawmakers.
item.dc:creator: Hannah Lang
item.content:encoded: Stand With Crypto, an advocacy group backed by crypto giant Coinbase (COIN.O) , on Monday endorsed 32 incumbent congressional candidates for the November midterm elections, as the industry cements influence in Washington. The endorsements, first reported by Reuters, come as the Clarity Act, the crypto industry's top policy priority, stalls in the Senate amid opposition from some lawmakers. All the candidates endorsed voted last year to pass the bill out of the House of Representatives, and Stand With Crypto hopes to return those industry-friendly candidates to office. Crypto companies say the legislation would give them long-sought legal clarity. Stand With Crypto's 2026 campaign builds on its 2024 effort, the first cycle that the group was active, Mason Lynaugh, executive director of Stand With Crypto, said in an interview. "In 2024 we were very much proving that the crypto voter is real. In 2026 we're very much showing that we have the organizing capacity and that our advocates are a true voting bloc that can move the needle," said Lynaugh. Coinbase [USN:L1N3AU25A TEXT:"launched Stand With Crypto in 2023"] to jumpstart a grassroots advocacy campaign with the goal of advancing pro-crypto legislation. It aims to influence elections by organizing and mobilizing voters rather than through large campaign expenditures. It says it has more than 3 million registered U.S. "advocates." Stand With Crypto endorsed six congressional candidates in March who are running for reelection. Among the new raft of 32 endorsees are some of the industry's key House allies, including Republicans Tom Emmer, and Bill Huizenga, and Democrats Ritchie Torres and Josh Gottheimer. Several of the 32 are running in competitive races, like Arizona Republican Juan Ciscomani and Pennsylvania Republican Brian Fitzpatrick. "I think we can be the difference maker in some of these," Lynaugh said. The group said it will announce its Senate endorsements closer to Election Day. The crypto industry [USN:L1N4310KM TEXT:"spent $170 million"] supporting congressional candidates during the 2024 elections, many of whom won their races. That helped it score a victory last year when Congress passed the Genius Act, which created rules for dollar-backed crypto tokens called stablecoins, potentially boosting their adoption. The sector has already [USN:L1N43P0YD TEXT:"poured close to $200 million"] into the November midterm elections, underscoring its muscle in Congress. Much of that has been directed through Fairshake, a major super political action committee created to support pro-crypto candidates.

item.title: Líder da extrema esquerda deve chegar ao segundo turno da eleição presidencial na França, aponta pesquisa
item.description: O líder da extrema esquerda francesa, Jean-Luc Mélenchon, é considerado o rival mais provável da candidata da extrema direita, Marine Le Pen, no segundo turno das eleições presidenciais da França do próximo ano, segundo uma pesquisa divulgada nesta segunda-feira, o que ressalta a profunda polarização do eleitorado à medida que a Presidência de Emmanuel Macron chega ao fim.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: O líder da extrema esquerda francesa, Jean-Luc Mélenchon, é considerado o rival mais provável da candidata da extrema direita, Marine Le Pen, no segundo turno das eleições presidenciais da França do próximo ano, segundo uma pesquisa divulgada nesta segunda-feira, o que ressalta a profunda polarização do eleitorado à medida que a Presidência de Emmanuel Macron chega ao fim. Mélenchon, candidato do partido de extrema esquerda “França Insubmissa” (LFI), deve chegar ao segundo turno em pelo menos três dos cinco cenários analisados na pesquisa, enquanto empatou em segundo lugar em um quarto cenário. Le Pen deve derrotá-lo facilmente no segundo turno. A pesquisa traz um quadro preocupante para os candidatos centristas da França, que enfrentam dificuldades para alcançar um eleitorado cada vez mais polarizado. À medida que o segundo e último mandato de Macron chega ao fim, o presidente impopular deixa para trás um centro político enfraquecido e uma economia frágil, abrindo espaço para partidos de linha dura, como o LFI e o Reunião Nacional, de Le Pen. “O risco de a Sra. Le Pen e o Sr. Mélenchon se enfrentarem no segundo turno é real e grave”, disse o candidato centrista Edouard Philippe aos repórteres nesta segunda-feira. Estima-se que Mélenchon obtenha cerca de 16% a 17% no primeiro turno, enquanto Le Pen obteria de 35% a 38% dos votos. Le Pen conquistaria 64% dos votos contra Mélenchon no segundo turno. Mélenchon já concorreu três vezes à Presidência, em 2012, 2017 e 2022, mas nunca conseguiu chegar ao segundo turno. (Reportagem de Inti Landauro)

item.title: White Sox, Rangers offer possible playoff preview
item.description: A game between two teams that stand a combined five games over .500 heading into the final week of August would not normally be considered a potential playoff preview.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: A game between two teams that stand a combined five games over .500 heading into the final week of August would not normally be considered a potential playoff preview. But in the parity-ridden American League, the Chicago White Sox and Texas Rangers might be offering a glimpse of a possible division-series duel Monday night when the White Sox host the Rangers in the opener of a three-game series. Jose Urquidy (2-1, 5.06 ERA) is expected to start for the White Sox against the Rangers' Kumar Rocker (4-10, 4.46) in a contest of right-handers. Both teams won the rubber game of a three-game series at home on Sunday afternoon. Tristan Peters hit a walk-off homer in the ninth inning to lift the White Sox to a 2-1 win over the New York Mets, and Cal Quantrill tossed six scoreless innings and earned the victory for the Rangers as they beat the Los Angeles Angels 5-3. The White Sox's second walk-off win of the weekend kept them 3 1/2 games ahead of the Cleveland Guardians atop the AL Central race and continued one of the season's most surprising Cinderella stories. The walk-off win was the 11th of the season for the White Sox, who are 23-20 in one-run games after a combined 47-95 in such contests over the previous three seasons -- a span in which Chicago was 162-324 overall. "It replicates playoff games pretty well with how close they are and how late they are," White Sox rookie outfielder Sam Antonacci said of the one-run wins. "Being able to have a bunch of those under our belt if we are fortunate enough to make the playoffs, that's one of our goals. Just hit the ground running." Chicago (68-62) also is 3 1/2 games ahead of the Rangers and the Houston Astros, the AL West co-leaders, for the second seed in the AL and the final playoff bye. The Guardians, Rangers and Astros are 65-66. The Rangers and Guardians are tied for the final wild-card spot, though there are five teams within 3 1/2 games of them. The win Sunday gave Texas at least a share of first place in the AL West for the first time since July 30 and continued its roller-coaster month. The Rangers won four straight games immediately following the Aug. 3 trade deadline before losing six of eight. Texas then went 4-2 against the Angels and Washington Nationals while allowing just 13 runs during the six-game homestand that ended Sunday. "Could we have played better? Of course," Rangers manager Skip Schumaker said. "I think anybody would say that in that clubhouse. However, the goal is to win each series, and we did that." Urquidy, who would make his first start of the season, earned the win last Wednesday, when he tossed six scoreless innings of bulk relief as the White Sox beat the Chicago Cubs 3-0. The White Sox acquired Urquidy from Pittsburgh before the trade deadline for a minor league pitching prospect, and he is 2-0 with a 2.79 ERA since. Rocker took the defeat Wednesday after allowing two runs over five innings in the Rangers' 6-0 loss to the Nationals. Urquidy is 5-0 with a 2.82 ERA in seven career starts against the Rangers, and Rocker is 2-0 with an 0.00 ERA in two starts against the White Sox spanning 11 innings. Rocker threw six scoreless, one-hit innings against the White Sox on July 21, earning the 10-0 win. --Field Level Media

item.title: China's Xi likely to visit India with big delegation for first time in seven years
item.description: Chinese President Xi Jinping is likely to attend next month's BRICS summit in New Delhi with a large delegation, three sources said, in what would be his first visit in seven years and a fresh sign of a thaw between the rivals.
item.dc:creator: Saurabh Sharma, Aftab Ahmed
item.content:encoded: Chinese President Xi Jinping is likely to attend next month's BRICS summit in New Delhi with a large delegation, three sources said, in what would be his first visit in seven years and a fresh sign of a thaw between the rivals. India is hosting the September 12 to 13 summit, where Xi's presence would be watched less for the BRICS agenda than for what it signals about Beijing and New Delhi's efforts to stabilise relations after deadly border clashes in 2020. "Chinese officials are busy finalising hotels and security protocols," one of the Indian sources with direct knowledge told Reuters. Last year, Indian [USN:L4N3UH09J TEXT:"Prime Minister Narendra Modi"] visited China for the first time in seven years, but the relationship has only improved gradually. More recently, a fresh border-related dispute triggered sharp diplomatic exchanges between the two sides. Two other Indian sources said Xi was likely to be accompanied by a delegation of about 400 officials, compared with fewer than 200 officials the last time in 2019. Officials from both countries are expected to use the summit to explore ways to expand engagement while managing long-standing differences over the border and regional security issues, the sources added. Xi's final travel plans and agenda for any potential bilateral between India and China are yet to be finalised, the sources said. The Chinese foreign ministry said, "China attaches great importance to and actively participates in BRICS cooperation, and supports India, the current chair, in successfully hosting this year's BRICS summit." "We currently have no information available to provide" about Xi's visit, it said. Xi missed the last BRICS summit in 2025 in Brazil. India's foreign ministry did not comment. INDIA-CHINA BORDER ISSUE The world's two most populous nations, both nuclear powers, share a roughly 3,800-km (2,400-mile), largely undemarcated and disputed border in the Himalayas. Decades of relative peace along the border were shattered by 2020 clashes where 20 Indian and four Chinese soldiers were killed. The incident led to a four-year military standoff before reaching a disengagement pact in October 2024. But on August 12, India said [USN:L4N449091 TEXT:"peace along the border was critical"] to ties after reports that Indian and Chinese army patrols came face-to-face in late July near a remote border. India's National Security Advisor Ajit Doval on Monday started his visit to Beijing to meet Chinese Foreign Minister Wang Yi to hold talks on the boundary issue. While India and China remain competitors, U.S. President Donald Trump's trade policies have created one area of convergence, making Xi's attendance a signal that neither side wants external pressure to undermine BRICS. ($1 = 95.7450 Indian rupees)

item.title: Crudo cae a la espera del anuncio de nuevas sanciones de EEUU contra Irán
item.description: Los precios del petróleo caían más de 1 dólar por barril el lunes, ya que los inversores recogían beneficios tras las recientes alzas y esperaban detalles sobre las nuevas sanciones que se espera que Estados Unidos imponga a Irán, lo que podría perturbar aún más el suministro procedente de Oriente Medio.
item.dc:creator: Robert Harvey
item.content:encoded: Los precios del petróleo caían más de 1 dólar por barril el lunes, ya que los inversores recogían beneficios tras las recientes alzas y esperaban detalles sobre las nuevas sanciones que se espera que Estados Unidos imponga a Irán, lo que podría perturbar aún más el suministro procedente de Oriente Medio. * A las 1131 GMT, los futuros del Brent restaban 1,16 dólares, o un 1,23%, a 93,23 dólares el barril, mientras que el West Texas Intermediate en Estados Unidos (WTI) restaba 1,55 dólares, o un 1,78%, a 85,51 dólares. * Ambos contratos registraron la semana pasada su segundo avance semanal consecutivo, con un aumento superior al 5%, en medio del estancamiento de las negociaciones de paz entre Estados Unidos e Irán, limitando los envíos petroleros a través del estrecho de Ormuz, una ruta por la que antes circulaba una quinta parte del suministro mundial. * El secretario del Tesoro estadounidense, Scott Bessent, que tiene previsto celebrar una rueda de prensa a las 1700 GMT, ha amenazado con imponer "las sanciones más duras de la historia" a Irán. El presidente Donald Trump también ha amenazado con imponer sanciones a los socios comerciales de Irán. * "Si se pone en marcha el embargo anunciado, el suministro de la región se reducirá", dijo Tamas Varga, analista de PVM, añadiendo que es probable que Washington endurezca su bloqueo naval contra las exportaciones de crudo iraníes y que Irán tome represalias contra instalaciones petroleras en Oriente Medio. * Irán ha condenado los planes estadounidenses de anunciar nuevas sanciones y el presidente Masoud Pezeshkian ha abogado por una solución diplomática. El jefe del ejército de Pakistán se encontraba el lunes de visita en Teherán para mantener conversaciones de mediación. * Menos de 20 buques de mercancías transitaron por el estrecho de Ormuz durante el fin de semana, según datos de transporte marítimo publicados el lunes, ya que los bloqueos iraní y estadounidense restringen el tráfico a través de este punto estratégico para los envíos de energía. * Sin embargo, Irán ha concedido permiso para que varios petroleros iraquíes atraviesen el estrecho tras repetidas peticiones de Bagdad, según informó el sábado la agencia estatal de noticias iraní IRNA.

item.title: Mexico's economy grows 1.4% in Q2 from previous quarter
item.description: Mexico's economy grew 1.4% in the second quarter from the previous three-month period, national statistics agency INEGI said on Monday, rebounding from a revised 0.3% contraction in the first quarter.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Mexico's economy grew 1.4% in the second quarter from the previous three-month period, national statistics agency INEGI said on Monday, rebounding from a revised [USN:L1N41Z0E3 TEXT:"0.3% contraction"] in the first quarter. All three main sectors tracked by INEGI posted growth during the period, with primary activities -- which include farming, fishing and mining -- leading the way with a 2.4% expansion. Growth, however, was slightly below INEGI's [USN:L1N43W0RC TEXT:"preliminary estimate"] of 1.5% published last month. In annual terms, Latin America's second-largest economy expanded 2.1% in the second quarter, the statistics agency said.

item.title: Indonésia afirma que número de mortos no terremoto de 15 de agosto chegou a 100
item.description: O número de mortos no terremoto que atingiu o leste da Indonésia chegou a 100 na segunda-feira, informou o chefe da agência de gestão de desastres, enquanto as operações de socorro continuavam pelo décimo dia consecutivo.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: O número de mortos no terremoto que atingiu o leste da Indonésia chegou a 100 na segunda-feira, informou o chefe da agência de gestão de desastres, enquanto as operações de socorro continuavam pelo décimo dia consecutivo. O terremoto de magnitude 7,7 sacudiu a província de Nusa Tenggara Oriental em 15 de agosto, seguido por milhares de réplicas, danificando mais de 73 mil casas e forçando a retirada de cerca de 180 mil pessoas. O número de mortos chegou a 100 à medida que mais pessoas em tratamento sucumbiram aos ferimentos, disse o chefe da agência de desastres, Suharyanto, em uma coletiva de imprensa, acrescentando que mais de 1.600 pessoas ficaram feridas. As autoridades estavam distribuindo ajuda humanitária por meio de helicópteros, caminhões e motos, de acordo com Suharyanto. O terremoto foi o mais mortal da Indonésia desde 2022, quando um terremoto raso de magnitude 5,6 matou centenas de pessoas em Java Ocidental. A Indonésia, um arquipélago com 290 milhões de habitantes, está localizada no “Anel de Fogo do Pacífico”, uma zona sismicamente ativa onde as placas tectônicas se encontram e terremotos e erupções vulcânicas são frequentes.

item.title: POINT MARCHÉS Wall Street vue en baisse, la géopolitique dans le viseur
item.description: Wall Street est attendue en baisse tandis que les Bourses européennes évoluent en ordre dispersé à mi-séance, les investisseurs hésitant face à la perspective de nouvelles sanctions américaines contre l'Iran, tout en attendant le discours du président de la Fed à Jackson Hole et les résultats de Nvidia.
item.dc:creator: Coralie Lamarque
item.content:encoded: Wall Street est attendue en baisse tandis que les Bourses européennes évoluent en ordre dispersé à mi-séance, les investisseurs hésitant face à la perspective de nouvelles sanctions américaines contre l'Iran, tout en attendant le discours du président de la Fed à Jackson Hole et les résultats de Nvidia. Les futures sur indices new-yorkais signalent une ouverture de Wall Street en baisse de 0,08% pour le Dow Jones (.DJI) , de 0,16% pour le Standard & Poor's-500 (.SPX) et de 0,49% pour le Nasdaq (.IXIC) . À Paris, le CAC 40 (.FCHI) perd 0,09% à 8.476,46 points vers 11h53 GMT. À Francfort, le Dax (.GDAXI) recule de 0,01% et à Londres, le FTSE 100 (.FTSE) prend 0,07%. L'indice EuroStoxx 50 (.STOXX50E) cède 0,06%, tandis que le FTSEurofirst 300 (.FTEU3) progresse de 0,01% et le Stoxx 600 (.STOXX) de 0,01%. Le Moyen-Orient continue de retenir l'attention des opérateurs, les États-Unis s'apprêtant à mettre en place des sanctions économiques visant les partenaires commerciaux de l'Iran, dans le cadre de ce qu'ils ont qualifié de "plus grande offensive financière de tous les temps", le secrétaire au Trésor américain Scott Bessent devant tenir une conférence de presse à 17h00 GMT. En parallèle, l'Iran [USN:L6N44L0EU TEXT:"menace"] de saisir les navires ne respectant pas les règles relatives au transit dans le détroit d'Ormuz, parmi d'autres restrictions, selon un message publié sur X par l'Autorité du détroit du golfe Persique (PGSA). Par ailleurs, le discours de Kevin Warsh lors du symposium annuel de la Réserve fédérale américaine (Fed) à Jackson Hole, dans le Wyoming, sera [USN:L6N44L0DY TEXT:"suivi de près"] cette semaine afin d’y déceler des indices sur la manière dont la banque centrale compte orienter sa politique monétaire dans un contexte de hausse des prix du pétrole et des rendements obligataires. "Nous ne savons plus qui contrôlera en fin de compte la partie longue de la courbe des taux américaine : le Trésor, la Fed ou le marché obligataire lui-même (...) Au vu de la réaction de la semaine dernière à l’annonce du Trésor, c’est toujours le marché qui a le dernier mot", a déclaré Ipek Ozkardeskaya, analyste senior chez Swissquote Bank. "Le rassemblement de Jackson Hole apportera un peu de clarté sur la manière dont la Fed s’inscrira dans ce contexte", a-t-elle ajouté. Selon les données LSEG, les marchés anticipent pleinement une hausse des taux d’intérêt de 25 points de base d’ici fin 2026. Dans le même temps, les investisseurs se préparent pour les résultats du géant américain des puces Nvidia (NVDA.O) , attendus mercredi, sachant que tout signe de ralentissement de croissance de la société la plus valorisée au monde pourrait raviver des inquiétudes sur l'intelligence artificielle (IA). LES VALEURS À SUIVRE À WALL STREET [USN:L8N44L0KB] VALEURS EN EUROPE Dans le sillage des inquiétudes quant à de nouvelles sanctions américaines attendues contre l'Iran, le compartiment des énergies fossiles (.SXEP) recule de 0,9%, affichant la pire performance sectorielle à mi-séance. Le secteur automobile plombe le CAC 40, Stellantis et Renault (RENA.PA) perdant respectivement 2,2% et 1,6%. PÉTROLE Les cours pétroliers sont en recul, alors que les investisseurs ont pris leurs bénéfices après les récentes hausses et attendent des précisions sur les nouvelles sanctions américaines attendues contre l'Iran, qui pourraient perturber davantage les approvisionnements en provenance du Moyen-Orient. "Si l'embargo annoncé venait à être mis en place, l'offre de pétrole en provenance de la région diminuerait", a déclaré Tamas Varga, analyste chez PVM, ajoutant que les États-Unis renforceraient probablement leur blocus naval contre les exportations de pétrole iraniennes et que l'Iran pourrait riposter par de nouvelles frappes contre des installations pétrolières au Moyen-Orient. Le Brent perd 1,53% à 92,95 dollars le baril et le brut léger américain (West Texas Intermediate, WTI) cède 2,12% à 85,21 dollars. Les deux principaux contrats ont enregistré la semaine dernière une deuxième hausse hebdomadaire consécutive, progressant de plus de 5%, alors que les négociations de paix entre les États-Unis et l’Iran restaient au point mort. TAUX En attendant les déclarations de Kevin Warsh à Jackson Hole, le rendement des Treasuries à dix ans perd 2,0 points de base à 4,7180%. Le deux ans abandonne quant à lui 0,4 point de base à 4,2380%. En Europe, le rendement du Bund allemand à dix ans reste stable à 3,2563%, tandis que le deux ans grappille 0,5 point de base à 2,8429%. CHANGES L'incertitude géopolitique profite aux valeurs refuge comme le billet vert, les cambistes attendant des précisions sur les sanctions américaines prévues contre l'Iran, en plus de des déclarations du président de la Fed. Le dollar gagne 0,18% face à un panier de devises de référence (.DXY) , tandis que l'euro perd 0,1% à 1,1667 dollar . item.title: India lenders' dollar debt sales top $10 billion since RBI window, ICICI Bank beats peer to lead pack
item.description: ICICI Bank , India's second-largest private lender, is tapping the U.S. dollar-denominated bond market for the fourth time in a month, under the central bank's discounted window, which will push overall issuances by banks above $10 billion.
item.dc:creator: Dharamraj Dhutia
item.content:encoded: ICICI Bank (ICBK.NS) , India's second-largest private lender, is tapping the U.S. dollar-denominated bond market for the fourth time in a month, under the central bank's discounted window, which will push overall issuances by banks above $10 billion. ICICI Bank is planning to raise $1 billion through private placement of five-year bonds at a coupon of 5.41%, two merchant bankers said, requesting anonymity as they are not authorised to speak to media. The private bank did not reply to Reuters' query seeking comment. The latest placement will take the aggregate funds raised by ICICI Bank under the Reserve Bank of India's discounted window to $3.05 billion, leading the charts. It has also helped ICICI Bank overtake HDFC, the country's largest private-sector bank, which has raised an aggregate of $2.50 billion so far. Towards the end of July, ICICI Bank raised $1 billion through a five-year paper at 100 basis points over Treasuries, with a 5.46% coupon, and that was its first issuance in nearly nine years. In early August, the lender reissued these papers at a yield of 5.3520%, raising $300 million, while last week it raised $750 million through five-year papers at a spread of 105 basis points over Treasuries at a 5.4170% coupon. The sale further extends a wave of offshore fundraising by Indian lenders after the central bank opened a concessional swap window for foreign-currency deposits, with total proceeds from bond issuances at $10.3 billion. Banks have been able to raise cheaper funds since the window was announced on June 5, giving them rupee liquidity that can support lending and investment and help margins. In the last few days, banks have been scrambling to complete their dollar issuances, with most funds being used to provide leverage to customers who will be depositing these funds under the discounted dollar deposit scheme. Earlier this month, the RBI said the window provided to banks for hedging non-resident deposits would end a month early on August 31.

item.title: Zambia closes courts on last day to file election challenge
item.description: Zambian authorities closed the country's top courts on Monday, blocking access to the premises on the last day that the opposition could file a challenge to this month's disputed election.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Zambian authorities closed the country's top courts on Monday, blocking access to the premises on the last day that the opposition could file a challenge to this month's disputed election. A memorandum from the chief administrator of the judiciary, which was seen by Reuters, said that "for security reasons, all members of staff are advised not to report for work today". Police spokesman Godfrey Chilabi told Reuters that security assessments were ongoing, and declined to give details. A spokesperson for the judiciary could not be reached. Opposition leader Brian Mundubile said last week that he was planning to file a petition at the Constitutional Court to [USN:L8N44G1E8 TEXT:"challenge the results"] of an August 13 election in which he came second to [USN:L4N4430J2 TEXT:"President Hakainde Hichilema"]. The deadline to file such a challenge is seven days after the result was announced, which would be in the early hours of Tuesday. OPPOSITION STILL AIMING TO FILE PETITION At the Supreme Court premises in Lusaka, which also includes the Constitutional Court, all of the gates were closed and police could be seen inside. Hichilema [USN:L8N44E0NB TEXT:"won re-election"] with about 60% of votes in the Southern African copper producer, but two reports by independent observers found indications the that Hichilema's vote count was inflated. Hichilema has denied any fraud. Following the arrests of several of his associates, Mundubile was [USN:L1N44I06F TEXT:"summoned by police"] for questioning last week in connection with alleged national security threats, which he says are fabricated. Analysts and human rights lawyers said they suspected he might be prevented from filing his petition, though Hichilema's party said that Mundubile was free to use the legal routes available to him. "We are trying our best to ensure that the petition is filed but we will see how it goes," said New Heritage Party President Chishala Kateka, whose party belongs to Mundubile's opposition alliance.

item.title: Museum heists have turned more violent, with thieves hired on social media, Europol says
item.description: Art thieves in Europe are committing more violent robberies focusing on gold and jewels, and specialist gangs have been replaced by ad-hoc opportunists recruited through social media, Europol said on Monday.
item.dc:creator: Julia Payne
item.content:encoded: Art thieves in Europe are committing more violent robberies focusing on gold and jewels, and specialist gangs have been replaced by ad-hoc opportunists recruited through social media, Europol said on Monday. The heist at the [USN:L2N3W000K TEXT:"Louvre Museum"] in Paris in October last year was a prime example of these shifts, Europol said, as the thieves threatened guards and visitors, and stole €88 million worth of jewels such as Empress Eugenie's [USN:L1N3W20UL TEXT:"tiara"]. Over the last two years, art thieves have shifted their attention to precious metals, jewels and cultural artefacts that offer greater profits, the EU's law enforcement agency said in a report. The price of gold has [USN:L8N44A0UZ TEXT:"surged"] 85% over the past two years, as investors and central banks turn to the metal as a safe haven. The London Bullion Market Association, which oversees London's over-the-counter gold trading hub, has warned that "as gold prices rise to historic levels, illicit flows and market distortions are also increasing." Europol said: "offenders are breaching premises and display cases using tools such as sledgehammers, axes, crowbars and, in some instances, explosives." Where traditional gangs used "deception and stealth", had a central leader and niche expertise, recent thefts were carried out by a decentralised ad-hoc group of profit-seeking opportunists, recruited through social media on a "crime-as-a-service" basis, it said. Europol added thieves were increasingly targeting gold items from nuggets and coins to jewels. "Precious metals can be easily melted down, leaving no trace for law enforcement, and facilitating illicit sales during the fencing process. Precious stones in jewellery, on the other hand, can be easily removed and sold further," the report said. In January last year, thieves used [USN:L1N40L0IB TEXT:"explosives"] to steal a 2,500-year-old Dacian golden helmet and three ancient gold bracelets from a museum in the Netherlands. The artefacts were later recovered and returned to Romania, although one bracelet is still missing. Europol also noted an increase in thefts of ancient Chinese porcelain artefacts such as Ming Dynasty vases due to high demand.

item.title: British household energy debts hit £6 billion, industry group says
item.description: British households owe £6 billion ($8.18 billion) in unpaid energy debt and arrears, industry group EnergyUK said on Monday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: British households owe £6 billion ($8.18 billion) in unpaid energy debt and arrears, industry group EnergyUK said on Monday. Regulator Ofgem is expected to announce this week a 4% increase in its domestic price cap, taking it to a [USN:L8N44F109 TEXT:"three-year high"]. EnergyUK presented the updated debt figure in a call with journalists on Monday ahead of the price cap announcement and said the data represented debt at the end of June 2026. Unrecovered energy debt is spread across all consumer bills and currently adds around £50 a year or around 3% to a typical annual bill. EnergyUK said the debt figure is likely to reach £7 billion by the end of the year without intervention. Regulator Ofgem has been looking at options to help indebted consumers but a scheme to [USN:L8N41O0UX TEXT:"clear £500 million"] of debt for the poorest customers, which needs government legislation, has stalled. Wholesale energy prices, which have soared this year due to the Iran war , are the largest single factor contributing to the domestic price cap, which is set on a quarterly basis using a formula that also reflects suppliers' network costs and environmental and social levies. ($1 = 0.7339 pounds)

item.title: Ataque ucraniano com drone mata três adolescentes em Krasnodar, na Rússia, segundo autoridades
item.description: Três adolescentes morreram e outras oito pessoas, incluindo crianças, ficaram feridas depois que destroços de um drone atingiram uma creche particular na região de Krasnodar, no sul da Rússia, durante a madrugada, segundo autoridades russas.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Três adolescentes morreram e outras oito pessoas, incluindo crianças, ficaram feridas depois que destroços de um drone atingiram uma creche particular na região de Krasnodar, no sul da Rússia, durante a madrugada, segundo autoridades russas. Em uma postagem no Telegram, a comissária russa para os direitos da criança, Maria Lvova-Belova, informou que três adolescentes, com idades de 13, 15 e 16 anos, morreram, e outras seis crianças foram hospitalizadas. O governador local, Veniamin Kondratyev, disse que dois adultos também ficaram feridos. Kondratyev afirmou em um comunicado no Telegram que as mortes ocorreram depois que destroços de um drone atingiram uma creche particular na cidade de Krasnodar. Não houve comentários imediatos de Kiev. O ataque ocorreu enquanto a Ucrânia atacava vários centros logísticos pertencentes à varejista online russa Ozon, inclusive na cidade de Enem, próxima à cidade de Krasnodar. A Ozon informou que também havia esvaziado depósitos nas regiões vizinhas de Adygea e Stavropol, enquanto outro depósito no Daguestão havia sido alvo de ataque. A Ucrânia intensificou os ataques a centros logísticos e depósitos em toda a Rússia, aproximando a guerra — iniciada pela Rússia em fevereiro de 2022 — dos russos comuns, alguns dos quais ganham a vida com a venda de produtos online. Em declarações publicadas no sábado, o presidente russo, Vladimir Putin, afirmou que Kiev havia aberto uma “caixa de Pandora” com seus ataques a alvos econômicos russos e que Moscou retaliaria contra os “setores econômicos mais sensíveis” da Ucrânia. Tanto a Rússia quanto a Ucrânia negam ter como alvo deliberadamente civis. Mais de 16 mil civis foram mortos em quase quatro anos e meio de conflito, segundo as Nações Unidas, sendo a esmagadora maioria deles ucranianos.

item.title: Colheita de milho segunda safra no centro-sul avança para 92%, diz AgRural
item.description: A colheita de milho segunda safra na região centro-sul do Brasil atingiu 92% da área até a última quinta-feira, avançando 7 pontos percentuais frente à semana anterior e contra 98% registrados um ano atrás, segundo levantamento da AgRural divulgado nesta segunda-feira.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: A colheita de milho segunda safra na região centro-sul do Brasil atingiu 92% da área até a última quinta-feira, avançando [USN:S0N44906Q TEXT:"7 pontos percentuais"] frente à semana anterior e contra 98% registrados um ano atrás, segundo levantamento da AgRural divulgado nesta segunda-feira. Em nota, a consultoria afirmou que os trabalhos estão encerrados em Mato Grosso e muito próximos do fim em Goiás e Minas Gerais, enquanto no Paraná "o ritmo melhorou, mas a umidade ainda mantém a colheita mais lenta que o normal". Já o plantio da primeira safra de milho 2026/27 no centro-sul alcançou 2% da área, ante 0,3% uma semana antes e 3,2% um ano atrás. Além do Rio Grande do Sul, Paraná e Santa Catarina também estão com máquinas em campo.

item.title: Antonelli dice que Mercedes ya no tiene el auto más rápido de la F1
item.description: El actual líder del campeonato mundial de Fórmula Uno, el italiano Kimi Antonelli, afirmó tras el Gran Premio de Países Bajos del domingo que McLaren ha dado un gran paso adelante y Mercedes ya no tiene el auto más rápido del circuito.
item.dc:creator: Alan Baldwin
item.content:encoded: El actual líder del campeonato mundial de Fórmula Uno, el italiano Kimi Antonelli, afirmó tras el Gran Premio de Países Bajos del domingo que McLaren ha dado un gran paso adelante y Mercedes ya no tiene el auto más rápido del circuito. El vigente campeón mundial, Lando Norris (McLaren), celebró su segunda victoria consecutiva partiendo desde la pole position en Zandvoort, seguido por los Mercedes de Antonelli y George Russell y los Ferrari de Lewis Hamilton y Charles Leclerc. "Está claro que ya no tenemos el auto más rápido de la parrilla", afirmó Antonelli, que ganó cinco carreras seguidas a principios de temporada. "Probablemente seamos segundos o terceros, al menos en la carrera de hoy, y McLaren ha dado un gran paso adelante, sobre todo desde Hungría, cuando introdujeron un gran paquete de mejoras". Norris, que perdió terreno frente a Antonelli al reanudarse la carrera y luego tuvo que adelantarle en pista, cuestionó sin embargo esa afirmación. "No creo que sea cierto. Creo que si no hubiera adelantado a Kimi cuando lo hice, no habría ganado la carrera", afirmó. "Por una vez, me daría un poco de crédito por sentir que estoy haciendo un mejor trabajo que los demás, y creo que eso también puede marcar la diferencia". "Sin duda, ahora tenemos un auto capaz de vencerles (…) pero creo que ellos tienen un rendimiento global mejor que el nuestro", agregó. Zandvoort, y antes el Hungaroring de Budapest, favorecieron los puntos fuertes de McLaren, pero algunos de los próximos circuitos pueden ser menos favorables. Cabe esperar que Ferrari rinda bien en Monza en septiembre, con mejoras en camino, mientras que Antonelli se enfrenta a importantes sanciones por un cambio de motor. Mercedes sigue muy por delante de Ferrari y McLaren en el campeonato de constructores y sumó más puntos (46, frente a los 43 de McLaren y los 31 de Ferrari) que nadie durante el fin de semana. "Tenemos un auto fuerte en ciertos aspectos. No es como el año pasado, en el que éramos bastante buenos en todas partes", afirmó Norris. "Somos muy, muy fuertes a alta velocidad, y ahí es donde más hemos mejorado: en el rendimiento a alta velocidad. Nadie nos iguala a alta velocidad, y eso es algo positivo". "Pero la ventaja que ellos (Mercedes) tienen sobre nosotros a baja velocidad también es enorme. Y, por eso, no tengo la confianza necesaria para decir: 'Sí, puedo luchar fácilmente por el campeonato durante el resto de la temporada'", señaló. "Sé que acabo de ganar dos carreras consecutivas y he logrado dos poles seguidas, pero en este momento no tengo el auto que necesito para luchar por el campeonato", añadió el británico, que se encuentra a 83 puntos de Antonelli a falta de 11 pruebas, a menos que la crisis en Oriente Medio obligue a modificar el calendario. El jefe de Mercedes, Toto Wolff, afirmó que las restricciones del límite de gastos impiden a Mercedes disponer del dinero necesario para introducir mejoras en el bólido tan rápido como les gustaría. "Estamos intentando repartir eso de forma equitativa a lo largo de la temporada, basándonos en nuestros cálculos sobre cuándo podemos introducir las actualizaciones más importantes y optimizar los puntos del campeonato", dijo a la prensa. "Así que el camino ha sido un poco más duro que a principios de año". El director de McLaren, Andrea Stella, afirmó que espera que Mercedes acelere el desarrollo de su monoplaza de todos modos. "Estoy seguro de que su monoplaza en el túnel de viento es bastante más rápido que el que tienen en pista", afirmó el italiano. "Y ahora querrán convertir parte de ese potencial en mejoras que se apliquen al auto real. Estoy bastante seguro de que tendrán mejoras".

item.title: Porsche verkauft Beratungstochter MHP an Tata Consultancy Services
item.description: Der Autobauer Porsche verkauft seine Management- und IT-Beratung MHP vollständig an den indischen IT-Dienstleister Tata Consultancy Services (TCS). Beide Unternehmen unterzeichneten einen entsprechenden Vertrag, wie der Stuttgarter Sportwagenbauer am Montag mitteilte. Der Abschluss des Geschäfts wird in den kommenden Monaten erwartet. Finanzielle Details wurden zunächst nicht genannt. Mit dem Verkauf will sich Porsche im Rahmen seiner Strategie "Sportwagenschmiede35" stärker auf das Kerngeschäft konzentrieren. Das Unternehmen stellte deshalb bereits die eigene Batteriezellfertigung, eine Softwarefirma und das Geschäft mit E-Bikes ein.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Der Autobauer Porsche (P911_p.DE) verkauft seine Management- und IT-Beratung MHP vollständig an den indischen IT-Dienstleister Tata Consultancy Services (TCS.NS) (TCS). Beide Unternehmen unterzeichneten einen entsprechenden Vertrag, wie der Stuttgarter Sportwagenbauer am Montag mitteilte. Der Abschluss des Geschäfts wird in den kommenden Monaten erwartet. Finanzielle Details wurden zunächst nicht genannt. Mit dem Verkauf will sich Porsche im Rahmen seiner Strategie "[USN:L8N43T0JC TEXT:"Sportwagenschmiede"]35" stärker auf das Kerngeschäft konzentrieren. Das Unternehmen stellte deshalb bereits die eigene Batteriezellfertigung, eine Softwarefirma und das Geschäft mit E-Bikes ein. Parallel zum Verkauf planen Porsche und TCS eine strategische Zusammenarbeit bei digitalen Lösungen und Künstlicher Intelligenz (KI). MHP soll zudem als eigenständige Marke und Beratungshaus innerhalb der Tata-Gruppe erhalten bleiben. Die Verbindung der Automobilexpertise von Porsche mit der Technologie- und KI-Expertise von TCS werde die Innovationskraft stärken, erklärte Porsche-Chef Michael Leiters. Die in Ludwigsburg bei Stuttgart ansässige MHP beschäftigt weltweit mehr als 4500 Mitarbeiter und berät seit mehr als 30 Jahren Unternehmen bei IT-Transformationen, insbesondere in der Automobil- und Fertigungsindustrie. MHP soll ein wichtiger Partner für die Digitalisierung von Porsche bleiben. Der neue Eigentümer TCS gehört zur indischen Tata-Gruppe und bietet IT-Dienstleistungen sowie Beratung in 55 Ländern an.

item.title: Altria, Philip Morris International sign contract manufacturing deals
item.description: Philip Morris International and Altria said on Monday they had entered contract manufacturing arrangements with one another, as Altria looks to grow cigarette imports and exports and take advantage of a tax rebate.
item.dc:creator: Emma Rumney
item.content:encoded: Philip Morris International (PM.N) and Altria (MO.N) said on Monday they had entered contract manufacturing arrangements with one another, as Altria looks to grow cigarette imports and exports and take advantage of a tax rebate. The rebate, known as the 'double duty drawback', allows U.S. tobacco companies exporting their products outside of the U.S. to claw back federal excise taxes paid on domestically sold products, offering a significant boost to U.S. profits. Altria, which makes Marlboro cigarettes in the United States but does not sell tobacco elsewhere, is [USN:L4N3YU1OO TEXT:"boosting partnerships"] with foreign manufacturers in order to grow its imports and exports Philip Morris International, which makes Marlboro for the rest of the world and does not sell tobacco in the United States, said the contract manufacturing deal with Altria does not change this and it has no plans to sell cigarettes in the U.S. Altria said that the arrangement will enhance efficiency and generate "economic benefits" The first shipments are expected in 2027, PMI said. Both companies said they do not expect the arrangements to affect 2026 performance Altria said in January it expects a profit boost in the second half of 2026 thanks to similar partnerships with other manufacturers Altria is the former parent company of PMI, formerly its international unit that was spun off in 2008

item.content:encoded: Die Ukraine strebt nach den Worten von Präsident Wolodymyr Selenskyj Frieden an, dies aber nicht zu dem Preis einer bedingungslosen Kapitulation. "Die Ukraine will unbedingt Frieden, doch sie ist nicht bereit, sich einfach zu ergeben", sagte Selenskyj am Montag in einer Videobotschaft vor dem Kiewer St.-Michaels-Kloster anlässlich des 35. Jahrestags der Unabhängigkeit des Landes von der Sowjetunion. An den Feierlichkeiten in der ukrainischen Hauptstadt nahmen zahlreiche ausländische Staatsgäste teil, darunter der britische Premierminister Andy Burnham und EU-Ratspräsident Antonio Costa. Burnham sollte am Montag zudem gemeinsam mit dem französischen Präsidenten Emmanuel Macron und Bundeskanzler Friedrich Merz eine teils virtuelle, teils als Präsenztreffen geplante Konferenz der "Koalition der Willigen" zur Unterstützung der Ukraine leiten. Dabei sollte es vor allem um die ukrainische Bitte um mehr Flugabwehrsysteme gehen. Die Bundesregierung unterstützt dies und fordert von den Bündnispartnern, ihre Bestände zu prüfen. "Auch dem dient dieses Gespräch heute", sagte Regierungssprecher Stefan Kornelius. Die Bundesregierung bekräftigte, dass sie die Ukraine mit weiteren Patriot-Flugabwehrraketen unterstützen wolle, bestätigte aber nicht die von Selenskyj genannte Zahl von 600. "ZWANGSVORSTELLUNG EINER EINZELNEN PERSON" Selenskyj wies die russische Forderung nach einer Abtretung des verbliebenen Teils der ostukrainischen Donbass-Region zurück. Dies werde die russische Aggression nicht aufhalten. "All dies wird von der Zwangsvorstellung einer einzelnen Person angetrieben, dass die Ukraine nicht existieren darf", sagte Selenskyj mit Blick auf den russischen Präsidenten Wladimir Putin. "Der Kreml ist davon besessen." Putin fordert, dass die Ukraine die noch von ihr gehaltenen Gebiete in den Regionen Donezk und Luhansk abtritt. "Die Ukraine ist anders, und sie gibt nicht her, was ihr gehört", sagte Selenskyj. Der ukrainische Präsident dankte den Staats- und Regierungschefs unter anderem aus Finnland, Dänemark, Norwegen und den baltischen Staaten für deren Unterstützung und versprach eine Antwort auf Putins "ballistischen Terror". Er forderte den ukrainischen Waffenhersteller Fire Point auf, die Produktion des Marschflugkörpers "Flamingo" zu beschleunigen. Burnham signalisierte, dass Großbritannien die Nutzung geheimer britischer Technologie erlauben werde, damit die Ukraine mit der Produktion europäischer Scalp-Marschflugkörper beginnen könne. Der Kreml erklärte dazu, der Einsatz dieser Technologie gieße "Öl ins Feuer", und warnte London vor Konsequenzen. "MINDESTENS ERSTMAL EINEN WAFFENSTILLSTAND" Bundesaußenminister Johann Wadephul kündigte unterdessen einen neuen diplomatischen Anlauf zur Beendigung des Krieges an. Der CDU-Politiker sagte am Montag im Deutschlandfunk, er wolle noch im Lauf des Tages mit US-Außenminister Marco Rubio telefonieren, um ihm Eindrücke seiner jüngsten Ukraine-Reise zu schildern und ihn zu bitten, im Sinne der Ukraine persönlich aktiv zu werden. Bislang sei die US-Diplomatie im Wesentlichen in den Händen der Gesandten Jared Kushner und Steve Witkoff gewesen. Wadephul betonte, Russland werde sich militärisch nicht wie von Putin geplant durchsetzen können. Er wolle diesen Herbst nutzen, um "alles zu versuchen, dass wir eine diplomatische Lösung finden können - mindestens erstmal einen Waffenstillstand." Zudem spreche die Bundesregierung mit Ländern wie der Türkei, Ägypten und den Golfstaaten, die engere Kontakte zu Russland pflegten. Wadephul warb zudem bei Ländern wie Südkorea und Griechenland für die Lieferung von Patriot-Flugabwehrmunition an die Ukraine, erklärte jedoch, er habe noch keine Zu- oder Absagen erhalten. Die Bundeswehr habe bei ihren Lieferungen die Grenze des Verantwortbaren erreicht. BEHÖRDEN MELDEN DREI TOTE BEI ANGRIFF IN CHARKIW Auf den Tag genau seit viereinhalb Jahren wehrt sich die Ukraine mit westlicher Unterstützung gegen den groß angelegten völkerrechtswidrigen russischen Angriff. US-geführte Friedensgespräche sind ins Stocken geraten, da sich die Ukraine weigerte, Territorium abzutreten, und Putin auf seinen Maximalforderungen beharrt. Die Kämpfe toben entlang einer rund 1200 Kilometer langen Frontlinie vor allem im Osten der Ukraine. Zwar verlangsamte sich der russische Vormarsch in diesem Jahr und die Ukraine konnte im Südosten Gebiete zurückerobern. Dennoch bedrohen russische Truppen die strategisch wichtige Stadt Kostjantyniwka im Donbass. Zudem hat Russland im Sommer seine Luftangriffe auf ukrainische Städte weit hinter der Front verstärkt und nutzt dabei den ukrainischen Mangel an Flugabwehrraketen aus. Selenskyj erklärte am Samstag, dass die Verteidigungsanstrengungen der Ukraine in diesem Jahr durch eine Finanzierungslücke von 27 Milliarden Dollar erschwert würden. Zudem warnte er, dass Russland nach den Parlamentswahlen im September rund 300.000 zusätzliche Soldaten mobilisieren könnte. Unterdessen griff die Ukraine am Montag nach eigenen Angaben vier Logistikzentren des zweitgrößten russischen Online-Händlers Ozon im Süden Russlands mit Drohnen an. Bei einem russischen Angriff am Stadtrand von Charkiw im Nordosten der Ukraine wurden nach Angaben des regionalen Gouverneurs in der Nacht zum Montag drei Menschen getötet.

item.title: Reeling Rockies strive for success on road vs. struggling Nationals
item.description: Following a futile homestand, the Colorado Rockies will try to alter their direction when they open a seven-game trip starting Monday night against the Washington Nationals.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: Following a futile homestand, the Colorado Rockies will try to alter their direction when they open a seven-game trip starting Monday night against the Washington Nationals. The Rockies concluded an 0-6 homestand with a 7-2 loss to the Cleveland Guardians on Sunday. The Nationals, meanwhile, were swept by the Miami Marlins and will limp home after an abysmal 1-8 trip. The only Washington pitcher to win during the trek, right-hander Cade Cavalli, will start Monday night, and that could mean more bad news for the Rockies. Cavalli (11-5, 3.22 ERA) has given up three earned runs or less in each of his past 13 starts, going 8-1 with 81 strikeouts in 68 innings. He has pitched 14 innings without allowing a run in his last two starts, highlighted by an 11-strikeout performance over six frames in a 6-0 win against the Texas Rangers on Wednesday. "It's just a testament to the process ... coming in and being the exact same, not riding the highs, not riding the lows," Cavalli said. "Being consistent in who you are and your routine, that adds to the consistency on the field." In his only career start vs. Colorado, Cavalli scattered four hits over six scoreless innings in an 8-0 win on July 22. Rockies right-hander Ryan Feltner (5-7, 5.97 ERA) will look to bounce back from getting roughed up by the Los Angeles Dodgers on Tuesday. He gave up seven runs on eight hits over five innings in a 7-6 loss. "Probably not what Felt would want," Rockies manager Warren Schaeffer said. "I thought he competed well, maybe without all of his weapons." Over his last seven starts, Feltner is 2-5 with a 9.00 ERA. He allowed three runs in five innings of a no-decision in 2023 in his only career start vs. the Nationals. Washington lost the series finale against the Marlins 6-2 on Sunday. The Nationals managed just two runs in each contest of the three-game series. Dylan Crews and Jorbit Vivas each had an RBI double on Sunday for the Nationals. The highlight for Washington was Jacob Young's leaping catch at the wall in left-center field with the team trailing by a run in the third inning. "Anything kind of gives a spark," Young said. "I think that's what we need right now. We need to make something go our way. Can't kind of wish it to go away. We need to make something go our way, and [with] a couple plays, get the snowball start rolling and kind of get going." Nationals shortstop CJ Abrams missed Sunday's game with a left ankle sprain. The Rockies, meanwhile, unveiled a statue of Hall of Famer Larry Walker and then dropped their ninth straight home game. Brett Sullivan had an RBI double for Colorado, which was outscored 20-6 by the Guardians. Adding (minor) injury to insult, Rockies reliever Jimmy Herget was stung by a bee. Schaeffer came out to the mound, but Herget was fine and stayed in the game to complete two scoreless innings. "A little moment of levity on a rough day," Schaeffer said. --Field Level Media

item.title: Ghana's GoldBod buyers hit by funding delays, sources say
item.description: Companies licensed to buy gold for Ghana's artisanal gold marketing agency GoldBod have not been paid for up to three weeks, forcing some operators to halt purchases or borrow to stay in business despite surging bullion prices, five industry sources told Reuters.
item.dc:creator: Maxwell Adombila, Emmanuel Bruce
item.content:encoded: Companies licensed to buy gold for Ghana's artisanal gold marketing agency GoldBod have not been paid for up to three weeks, forcing some operators to halt purchases or borrow to stay in business despite [USN:L1N44L0BG TEXT:"surging bullion prices"], five industry sources told Reuters. Ghana, [USN:L8N3Z810C TEXT:"Africa's biggest gold producer"], established [USN:L8N3ZS2CE TEXT:"GoldBod"] in 2025 with exclusive rights to buy, sell and export artisanal gold as part of efforts to curb smuggling and [USN:L8N3ZL2BJ TEXT:"boost inflows of foreign currency"]. GoldBod purchases were funded initially by the Bank of Ghana and helped to boost [USN:L8N43P2NF TEXT:"Ghana's economic recovery"], but the IMF called for an end to central bank financing after losses linked to purchases, leaving the state agency reliant on commercial banks and gold importers for liquidity. The agency's chief executive, Sammy Gyamfi, told a press conference last week that GoldBod raised nearly $839 million in advances for purchases between March and May. A foreign exchange auction to commercial banks on August 3 raised about $75 million before being paused for consultations with the central bank. Three banking executives said the Bank of Ghana viewed GoldBod's auction programme as inconsistent with its operating framework and that both institutions were working to address the concerns. Kwaku Ohemeng Amoah, Chief Executive of the Chamber of Gold Buyers, said the delays reflected limits on GoldBod's funding after the central bank's exit, adding that buyers could seek supplementary funding themselves. GoldBod and the Bank of Ghana did not respond immediately to requests for comment. "The last two weeks were terrible. You could spend a whole day waiting and not receive any funds," a gold trader in Ghana's Ashanti Region said last week. Another GoldBod-funded buyer in Ghana’s Western Region said funds had not been received for about three weeks. The sources asked for anonymity because they were not authorised to speak publicly on the matter. The banking executives said that fewer than five banks participated in GoldBod's auction programme, adding that lenders were more comfortable when the central bank backstopped the arrangement.
